description: This file contains Makefile definitions for building and installing firmware packages for various Texas Instruments wireless chips, including wl12xx, wl18xx, ti-3410, and ti-5052. It specifies installation directories, firmware data files, symbolic links, and package build instructions.

methods.name: Package/wl12xx-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation procedure for WL12xx firmware, copying firmware data files into the target directory and creating symbolic links.

methods.name: Package/wl18xx-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation procedure for WL18xx firmware, copying the firmware binary into the target directory.

methods.name: Package/ti-3410-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation procedure for TI 3410 firmware, copying the firmware file into the target directory.

methods.name: Package/ti-5052-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation procedure for TI 5052 firmware, copying the firmware file into the target directory.
